references.text: Here reference is made to David's son as a title for the Messiah, reflecting the belief that the Messiah would come from David's lineage.
The prophecy that the Messiah will heal the blind, which is fulfilled in Jesus' healing of two blind men.
Another event where Jesus heals the blind, highlighting his compassion and power to heal.
The story of Bartimaeus, the blind beggar, who also calls Jesus 'David's son' and is healed, shows a parallel in faith and recognition of Jesus as the Messiah.
